items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I never got to play with Thelonious Monk but I’m sure that would have been different. I wish I had.

ctx.x: Or if that’s something that’s too intangible.

No. Well, I think, I hope I’ve in different ways talked about it quite a bit in the last couple of days. Yeah, it does. And as I said, the same as just conversations, like my conversation with you. You react to different situations differently according to people and… especially when you’re, you’re in a improvisatory art form kind of a… But I’m sure even classical musicians play differently even though the music is written with different accompanists and accomplices and orchestras and stuff so… Yeah, it’s a very……
